question: Jal Utsav Campaign seen in news in 2024 is an initiative of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 __ 
• **Jal Utsav Campaign** is an initiative led by **NITI Aayog** to highlight the importance of **water conservation** and sustainable management of water resources across India. 
• The campaign promotes the principles of **water security** and aims to raise awareness about the judicious use of water resources in the wake of growing water scarcity concerns. 
• It encompasses activities like **awareness drives, community participation programs, workshops, and educational campaigns** to engage people at the grassroots level. 
• **NITI Aayog** has been actively involved in preparing comprehensive reports and indices, such as the **Composite Water Management Index (CWMI)**, which provides a roadmap for effective water management practices. 
• Jal Utsav aligns with broader government initiatives such as the **Jal Jeevan Mission** and **Atal Bhujal Yojana**, focusing on water conservation and groundwater recharge. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **NITI Aayog:** 
• NITI Aayog, or the **National Institution for Transforming India**, was established on **January 1, 2015**, replacing the Planning Commission. 
• It serves as the **policy think tank** of the Government of India, providing directional and strategic input to development processes. 
• NITI Aayog emphasizes principles of **cooperative federalism** and works in collaboration with state governments to implement national policies and programs. 
• It has introduced initiatives like the **Aspirational Districts Programme** and **Digital India initiatives** to accelerate India's development. 
• **Composite Water Management Index (CWMI):** 
• Launched by NITI Aayog in **2018**, CWMI aims to assess and improve the management of water resources in states and union territories. 
• The index evaluates states on parameters like **groundwater restoration, irrigation status, and drinking water supply**. 
• It helps identify **best practices** and areas that require urgent attention in water management. 
• **Jal Jeevan Mission:** 
• Launched in **2019**, the Jal Jeevan Mission aims to provide **functional household tap connections (FHTCs)** to all rural households by **2024**. 
• The mission focuses on ensuring a supply of **55 liters of water per person per day** to every household. 
• It promotes community-led water management and emphasizes **source sustainability** through rainwater harvesting, groundwater recharge, and other initiatives. 
• **Atal Bhujal Yojana:** 
• Also known as the **Atal Jal**, this scheme was launched in **2020** by the Government of India to ensure **sustainable management of groundwater resources**. 
• The program emphasizes **community participation** and institutional strengthening for groundwater management. 
• It is implemented in **seven states**, including Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Water Scarcity in India:** 
• India is home to **16% of the world's population** but has only **4% of the world's freshwater resources**. 
• According to NITI Aayog's **2018 report**, **21 Indian cities** are likely to run out of groundwater by **2024**, affecting nearly **100 million people**. 
• Effective water conservation campaigns like Jal Utsav are crucial to addressing these challenges. </ul
